exclusions: Observed main-conference records, ML (ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS) and ACL, 2020–2022 or 2024–2026, matching broad agent/tool/memory title regex, with nonempty collected abstract. Excludes 2023, CVPR, title-negative papers, missing abstracts, and all NeurIPS 2026 records because their observed program is incomplete. ICML/ICLR/ACL 2026 remain included as collected; upstream source and track caveats apply.
scope: Complete frozen title-positive frame for the four audit strata. Not the full conference corpus; aggregate full-corpus denominators remain in sampling_manifest.json.
